title: MEDPI: EVALUATING AI SYSTEMS IN MEDICAL PATIENT-FACING INTERACTIONS

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Socioeconomic bias (Gender, Age, Race/Ethnicity, SES)
bias_targets.methodology: Simulating medical consultations using synthetic patient profiles that vary by gender, age, race/ethnicity, education, and socioeconomic status, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to score dimensions such as 'equity and justice' (treating patients fairly without discrimination) and 'health equity and access' (consideration of health disparities and cultural competency).

Using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate a specific 'bias awareness' rubric dimension, which checks whether cognitive biases like anchoring or stereotyping improperly influence the AI doctor's differential diagnosis list.
